fields.summary: TC-669-03: RRO Flag False When Actual DP Release DateTime Is Missing (Null)

content.text: Linked Story: CREWCMBR-669

Precondition: A trip exists with a Duty Period where the actualReleaseDateTimeUTC is null or absent (e.g., DP still in progress or data not yet available). Out of Scope: LCO, LRO, Guarantees, Special Rules.
TEST STEPS
Step
Action
Test Data
Expected Result
Set up a trip with a Duty Period where plannedReleaseDateTimeUTC is populated but actualReleaseDateTimeUTC is null or absent
DP1: plannedRelease = 2026-03-03T22:00:00Z, actualRelease = null
Trip payload is ready with planned release datetime but missing actual release datetime for the DP
Trigger the RRO Lambda with the trip payload
DP payload with null actualReleaseDateTimeUTC
Lambda is invoked successfully without errors
Verify the RRO lambda handles the missing actualReleaseDateTimeUTC gracefully without throwing an exception
actualReleaseDateTimeUTC = null
Lambda does not throw a NullPointerException or unhandled error and proceeds with default evaluation
Verify the rroEligible flag in the lambda output for the Duty Period
Cannot calculate delay - actual release datetime is null
rroEligible = false (cannot determine eligibility without actual release datetime)
Confirm the DB update lambda receives rroEligible = false and does not mark the DP as RRO eligible
Lambda output payload with rroEligible=false
DynamoDB record shows rroEligible = false on the Duty Period
